observations: Line 2 loads the item before any authorization check; load(id) is invoked unconditionally for every caller.
Line 3 compares item.owner to actor and throws Error("denied") for non-owners, matching the stated contract.
Line 4 returns item.amount only after the line 3 check, so the amount is not exposed to non-owners.
Probe p1 invoice(7, "bob") reaches line 3 with owner "alice" and throws, consistent with the contract.
Probe p2 invoice(7, "alice") passes line 3 and returns 40 from line 4.
No exception handling wraps load(id) on line 2, so a load failure propagates before the authorization check.
